topic: Rituximab in rheumatic disease: dosing, pre-treatment screening, hypogammaglobulinaemia

source.title: Rituximab for Rheumatoid Arthritis
source.whyItFits: Open review of rituximab in rheumatoid arthritis covering repeated-course hypogammaglobulinemia, immunoglobulin monitoring, and hepatitis B screening.

whyItFits: Open review of rituximab in rheumatoid arthritis covering repeated-course hypogammaglobulinemia, immunoglobulin monitoring, and hepatitis B screening.
coverageNote: Screening and hypogammaglobulinemia are explicit. A separate hypogammaglobulinemia cohort used a 2×1 g then 1 g every 6 months schedule; that dosing schedule is not imported into this paper's MCQs.
rejectedInAppHints: High SARS-CoV-2 mortality on rituximab was not the dosing and screening review requested.
